heroDescription: Beautiful hills, peaceful backwaters, tropical beaches and memorable experiences — planned around you.
packagesDescription: Choose a starting idea and let us customize the route, hotels, transport and experiences to match your dates and budget.
experienceDescription: Tea gardens in Munnar. Wildlife and spice country in Thekkady. A private houseboat through the backwaters. Sunset beaches in Kovalam and Varkala. Tell us what you want to experience — we will build the route.
destinationsDescription: Popular stops for your next Kerala holiday.
ctaDescription: Tell us your dates and what you want to see. We will suggest a route and package.
enquiryDescription: Share a few details and your enquiry will be prepared as a WhatsApp message. No payment is required to submit an enquiry.
